entries.text: Genesis — opens the append-only R-CORE record for the EASTER-EGG / SIM console at /sim: unlocked by the Powered-Badge Cyan → Sunset → Violet theme-click sequence, it hosts the Cube Dev-Sim (Cubes 1-9), the moderator/user session split-screen demo with a QR for a second device, and (for admins) the Simulation Admin Console. Earliest commit reachable in this shallow history that touched the surface: ef8b1c3.
Site-UX keyify batch 1 — the /sim page's hardcoded strings routed through t() so the SIM console renders in all 33 languages.
Admin Simulation Console tab added behind the easter-egg unlock: a question runs a 100-400-word simulation → Theme01 / Theme02 clustering → simulated ranking priorities.
The Cube Dev-Sim picker is laid out in the cubes' real 3×3 spiral positions from lib/cube-grid.ts, matching the Cube Architecture map.

R-CORE version-history badge mounted on the EASTER-EGG / SIM console (Stage 2): the bottom-centre two-click badge opens the R-CORE · Version History compare panel over this surface's own append-only ledger, so the evolution of the SIM / easter-egg menu is traceable through the same compare tool as more features land (operator 2026-09-25).
